# GitHub Copilot Repository Instructions

Read `AGENTS.md` and the relevant `standards/` and `presets/` guides before proposing or editing code in this repository.

## Core Rules
- Clarify requirements across the 7 dimensions (`standards/product-discovery.md`) and record `REQ-XXX` IDs before building.
- Simple brochure/portfolio sites follow `presets/static-site.md` (guidance only) and MUST NOT add auth, databases, or admin panels.
- Full-stack multi-tenant apps follow `presets/fullstack-web-app.md` (matching `templates/fullstack/`): Next.js App Router, TypeScript, Drizzle ORM, PostgreSQL/PGlite, Zod, Vitest, Playwright.
- Enforce server-side auth (`401`), RBAC (`403`), tenant `organizationId` isolation, CSRF Origin checks, bounded pagination (`limit <= 50`), versioned Drizzle migrations, and production fail-closed env validation (`standards/security.md`).
- Follow `standards/design-system.md` (no AI-slop gradients/glassmorphism/fake metrics; CSS tokens; all 7 UI states; `360/768/1440` screenshot review).
- Do not hand-edit generated adapter files; run `npm run sync:adapters` and verify via `npm run check:adapters` and `npm run test:repo`.
